title: Filipino Doraji Tagine
description: A unique and flavorful Filipino-inspired stew made with exotic spices, doraji, and steamed vegetables, slow-cooked to perfection in a traditional Moroccan tagine.

ingredients.name: Steamed Vegetables (e.g., carrots, potatoes, green beans)

instructions: Heat the coconut oil in the tagine over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and sauté until softened.
Add the exotic spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the doraji and steamed vegetables and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and vegetable broth, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 20-25 minutes or until the doraji is tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs (optional).
